description: Create a reusable component that prevents users from accidentally losing unsaved changes when navigating away from editing interfaces. This component should handle both browser-level navigation (tab closing, back button) and NextJS client-side routing events, and should be integrated into email templates, observability reports, and edge function creation/editing pages.
functional_requirements: Create a reusable React component that monitors for unsaved changes and displays a confirmation dialog when navigation is attempted
The component must handle both browser 'beforeunload' events and NextJS router change events to cover all navigation scenarios
Integrate the component into email template editing, observability report editing, and edge function creation/editing interfaces
The confirmation dialog should allow users to either cancel navigation (keeping their changes) or confirm navigation (discarding changes)
Ensure the component only triggers when there are actual unsaved changes to prevent unnecessary interruption
Maintain existing functionality in observability reports while extending the same protection to other editing interfaces
